# apple_promoted_purchase (Resource)

Promotes an in-app purchase or subscription on the app's App Store page, where customers can buy it before downloading the app. Set the order of an app's promotions with `apple_promoted_purchase_order`. Destroying the resource removes the promotion. Import it with `<app_id>/<id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_promoted_purchase" "pro" {
  app_id                = data.apple_app.example.id
  subscription_id       = apple_subscription.monthly.id
  visible_for_all_users = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `visible_for_all_users` (Boolean) Whether every customer sees the promotion, rather than only those the app shows it to with StoreKit.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the promotion is shown. Defaults to `true`.
- `in_app_purchase_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the in-app purchase to promote.
- `subscription_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the subscription to promote.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the promoted purchase.
- `state` (String) Review state of the promotion, e.g. `PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION` or `APPROVED`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_promoted_purchase.pro
  identity = {
    app_id = "1234567890"
    id     = "9876543210"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the promoted purchase.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_promoted_purchase.pro 1234567890/9876543210
```
